blocks.content: Quiz: Why does EntryCard call onDelete(id) instead of updating the entries list itself?
Tap an option below to answer:
So that the Delete button works without re-rendering
The list re-renders whenever the parent updates the state.
The list re-renders whenever the parent updates the state.
Because EntryCard is not allowed to use useState
EntryCard could use useState for other things. The issue is who owns the entries list.
EntryCard could use useState for other things. The issue is who owns the entries list.
Because passing the id would not work from inside EntryCard
Passing id works; the reason is about where the state lives.
Passing id works; the reason is about where the state lives.
Because App owns the entries state, not EntryCard
The state lives in the component that owns it; i.e., inside the parent component App. Children thus need to use callbacks to request changes.
